title: D3 family — HTML-in-JSON shape (hklrccp, hklrcr, pcpdc)
description: One JSON per (row, lang) at output/d3/{family}/{year}/{num}/{family}_{year}_{num}_{lang}.json. Covers the three D3 families whose HKLII response embeds the document HTML in `content` (Shape B, file_type=1 per docs/d3-runner-design.md). No separate .txt or .html file — run parser.html_to_text on `content` for plain text. Langs observed: en, tc, sc.

path.description: HKLII-relative path fragment for this document (e.g. '/2020/2/').

lang.description: Uppercase in this response (matches HKLII wire).

file_type.description: Always 1 on this shape. HKLII uses file_type=2 for external-PDF rows (see d3-pcpdaab.schema.json).

content.description: Embedded document HTML (report body, footnotes, tables of contents).

pdf.description: Empty string on this shape — the PDF field is only populated for file_type=2 rows.
